description: A simple equation. When entered into the Synthesizer, it will unlock a new recipe.
story:
Sometimes, happiness is hard to find, so hard that even a fortune can't buy it.
But sometimes, happiness is easy. All you need is a Happiness Coupon that represents vitality and dopamine.

"You want it? You got it! Redeem it anytime! We'll always foot the bill for your happiness!"
